name: 直播带货脚本
description: 从商品资料写出一场直播的脚本：流程表 → 逐段话术和弹幕问答（并行）→ 检查时长和违禁词。 / Write a live-selling stream script from your product notes: rundown → segment-by-segment script and chat Q&A (in parallel) → check timing and banned words.

price.description: 直播价和优惠，例如：直播间 99 元，前 100 单送杯套 / Stream price and offer

minutes.description: 这个商品讲几分钟 / Minutes for this product

host.description: 主播风格，例如：亲切的邻家姐姐、专业测评 / The host's style

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 商品资料
stages.description: 商品的真实参数和售后。话术里每个说法都要在这里找得到。 / The product's real specs and after-sales terms. Every claim in the script must be found here.

executor.instructions: 把 materials/product.md 换成你的商品资料。示例是虚构的榨汁杯。 / Replace materials/product.md with your product's facts. The sample is a fictional blender cup.

stages.name: 流程表
stages.description: 把时间分成几段：开场留人、痛点、演示、价格、逼单、返场，每段有分钟数和目标。 / Split the time into segments (hook, pain point, demo, price, close, recap), each with minutes and a goal.

stages.name: 话术
stages.description: 按流程表逐段写主播要说的话、要做的动作和要引导的互动。 / Write what the host says, does and asks the chat to do, segment by segment.

stages.name: 弹幕问答
stages.description: 观众最常在弹幕里问的问题和一句话回答，和话术并行。 / The questions viewers ask most in chat, with one-line answers, in parallel with the script.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 分钟数加起来对不对、每段话术有没有写、价格有没有说、绝对化用语和占位符。 / Do the minutes add up, is every segment written, is the price mentioned, any absolute claims or placeholders.
